d: Long, wavy platinum blonde hair flows past the shoulders with thick bangs framing the face, paired with wide, neutral-expression purple eyes. The face is that of a mature teenager with a slender, petite build. The outfit consists of a dark navy tactical jacket and matching mini-skirt with white side panels, a black tactical chest rig over the torso, dark navy thigh-high boots, and a dark navy helmet with red and white accents. Signature details include a large, heavy-duty tactical shield in dark navy, red, and white, and a small handgun held in one hand.
